title: Tiger cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tiger cub dancing - bright, clear shapes for LED screen -->
  <!-- Glow effect base -->
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFB347" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFB347" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Soft glow behind cub -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="45" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Tail - curved, behind body, orange with darker orange stripes -->
  <path d="M72 68 Q82 60 84 48 Q85 42 80 40" stroke="#FF8C00" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M81 42 Q84 44 83 48" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M79 52 Q82 54 81 58" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Back leg (left) - raised in dance -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="72" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#FF8C00" transform="rotate(-20 32 72)"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="74" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FFD59A" transform="rotate(-20 30 74)"/>

  <!-- Back leg (right) - on ground -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="74" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="76" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FFD59A"/>

  <!-- Body - orange oval -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="60" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#FF8C00"/>

  <!-- Body stripes - dark orange -->
  <path d="M34 55 Q38 58 35 63" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M42 52 Q45 56 43 60" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M54 53 Q57 57 55 62" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 56 Q62 60 60 64" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Belly - light cream -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="63" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#FFD59A"/>

  <!-- Front left arm - waving up -->
  <path d="M36 50 Q26 38 22 32" stroke="#FF8C00" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="21" cy="30" r="4" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <circle cx="19" cy="29" r="2.5" fill="#FFD59A"/>
  <path d="M33 43 Q30 40 32 37" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Front right arm - out to side -->
  <path d="M60 52 Q70 48 76 45" stroke="#FF8C00" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="44" r="4" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="43" r="2.5" fill="#FFD59A"/>
  <path d="M68 51 Q71 48 70 45" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="38" r="16" fill="#FF8C00"/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="26" r="7" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="26" r="4" fill="#FFD59A"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="26" r="7" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="26" r="4" fill="#FFD59A"/>

  <!-- Head stripes -->
  <path d="M44 24 Q44 28 44 32" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M52 24 Q52 28 52 32" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 34 Q42 37 46 35" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 34 Q54 37 50 35" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="44" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#FFD59A"/>

  <!-- Eyes - bright, happy -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="37" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="37" rx="4" ry="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="37" r="2.5" fill="#2E8B57"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="37" r="2.5" fill="#2E8B57"/>
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="36.5" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="55.5" cy="36.5" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <path d="M46 43 L50 43 L48 45 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>

  <!-- Happy mouth -->
  <path d="M45 46 Q48 49 51 46" stroke="#CC6600" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1="35" y1="42" x2="28" y2="40" stroke="#FFD59A" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="45" x2="28" y2="46" stroke="#FFD59A" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="61" y1="42" x2="68" y2="40" stroke="#FFD59A" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="61" y1="45" x2="68" y2="46" stroke="#FFD59A" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Dance motion lines around feet -->
  <path d="M20 78 Q24 76 22 72" stroke="#FFD59A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M72 78 Q76 76 74 72" stroke="#FFD59A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M16 68 Q18 64 14 62" stroke="#FFD59A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M82 66 Q80 62 84 60" stroke="#FFD59A" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="30" r="2" fill="#FFE66D" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="25" r="2" fill="#FFE66D" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#FFE66D" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#FFE66D" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
